description: This file defines CLI commands for tailing logs via RPC, including log fetching, formatting, error handling, and command registration.

methods.name: loadLogsCliRuntime
methods.description: Dynamically imports the logs-cli runtime module.

methods.name: fetchLogs
methods.description: Fetches logs from gateway or falls back to local logs if necessary.

methods.name: normalizeErrorMessage
methods.description: Converts unknown errors to string messages.

methods.name: shouldUseLocalLogsFallback
methods.description: Determines if fallback to local logs is appropriate based on error and connection details.

methods.name: formatLogTimestamp
methods.description: Formats log timestamps into human-readable strings.

methods.name: formatLogLine
methods.description: Formats a raw log line into a styled string based on options.

methods.name: createLogWriters
methods.description: Creates writers for log, error, and JSON output streams.

methods.name: emitGatewayError
methods.description: Handles errors related to gateway connectivity, outputs error messages.

methods.name: registerLogsCli
methods.description: Registers the 'logs' command in the CLI program, setting options and action handler.
